message.content: Jennifer Moore provides several practical tips for managing muscle soreness post-workout. One of the most emphasized is the importance of hydration, suggesting that staying hydrated helps with recovery. Additionally, she recommends engaging in light activities such as walking or gentle yoga, which can aid in alleviating soreness. Another tip includes spending time stretching the muscles post-workout, which can improve flexibility and relieve tension. Jennifer also advocates for the use of a foam roller on sore spots, as it effectively helps with muscle tightness. Lastly, Jennifer stresses the significance of adequate rest; she encourages her participants to ensure they have recovery days to allow their muscles time to heal.
